64546-moonglade.creator: Unknown
64546-moonglade.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. ying,   Shudders beneath the half-shut stars espying  Down from the steely night. Moonglade, O Moonglade, heavenly calm and still,   Moulding to beauty bitterness and ill,  I know, beholding thee,   Yet is there strength, and truth and constancy!

Our gratitude is extended to the Technology Advancement and Prototyping Centre (TAPC) at the Dhahran Techn
arxiv-2109-11910.creator: Asaad AlGhamdi, Louai Al-Awami
arxiv-2109-11910.description: Abstract This demo presents a functional Proof-of-Concept prototype of a smart bracelet that utilizes IoT and ML to help in the effort to contain pandemics such as COVID-19. The designed smart bracelet aids people to navigate life safely by monitoring health signs; and detecting and alerting people when they violate social distancing regulations.

arxiv-2208-12755.creator: Muhammad Firdaus, Kyung-Hyune Rhee
arxiv-2208-12755.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Muhammad Firdaus, Kyung-Hyune Rhee. The number of internet-connected devices has been exponentially growing with the massive volume of heterogeneous data generated from various devices, resulting in a highly intertwined cyber-physical system. Currently, the Edge Intelligence System (EIS) concept that leverages the merits of edge computing and Artificial Intelligence (AI) is utilized to provide smart cloud services with powerful computational processing and reduce decision-making delays. Thus, EIS offers a possible solution to realizing future Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS), especially in a vehicular network framework.

arxiv-2306-13849.creator: Edgar Medina-Segura, Leonardo Miranda-Culin, Valeria Rodríguez-Fajardo, Benjamin Perez-Garcia, Carmelo Rosales-Guzmán
arxiv-2306-13849.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Edgar Medina-Segura, Leonardo Miranda-Culin, Valeria Rodríguez-Fajardo, Benjamin Perez-Garcia, Carmelo Rosales-Guzmán. In this work, we propose and demonstrate experimentally a new family of vector beams, the Helico-Conical Vector Beams (HCVB), whose spatial degree of freedom is encoded in the Helico-Conical Optical Beams.

arxiv-2310-12090.description: Abstract We present a detailed chemical abundance analysis of the brightest star in the ultra-faint dwarf (UFD) galaxy candidate Cetus II from high-resolution Magellan/MIKE spectra. For this star, DES J011740.53-173053, abundances or upper limits of 18 elements from Carbon to Europium are derived.

arxiv-2311-01482.creator: Manjari Dutta a , Shreemoyee Ganguly b , Sunandan Gangopadhyay c a,c Department of Astrophysics and High Energy physics, S.N. Bose National Centre for Basic Sciences, JD Block, Sector III, Salt Lake, Kolkata 700106, India b Department of Basic Science and Humanities, University of Engineering and Ma
arxiv-2311-01482.description: Abstract This work explores the behaviour of a noncommutative harmonic oscillator in a time-dependent background, as previously investigated in [ 1 ] . Specifically, we examine the system when expressed in terms of commutative variables, utilizing a generalized form of the standard Bopp-shift relations recently introduced in [ 2 ] .

arxiv-2408-12573.title: Population Control of Giardia lamblia
arxiv-2408-12573.creator: Victor Hugo Pereira Rodrigues, Maria Fantinatti, Tiago Roux Oliveira, Wilton dos Santos Freitas
arxiv-2408-12573.description: Abstract Giardia lamblia is a flagellate intestinal protozoan with global distribution causing the disease known as giardiasis. This parasite is responsable for 35.1% of outbreaks of diarrhea caused by contaminated water which and mainly affects children in whom it can cause physical and cognitive impairment.

arxiv-2501-08264.title: Lipschitz Geometry of Mixed Pham-Brieskorn Singularities Thanks: The author was supported by the Coordenação de Aperfeiçoamento de Pessoal de Nível Superior - Brasil (CAPES) - Finance Code 001.
arxiv-2501-08264.creator: Inácio Rabelo
arxiv-2501-08264.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Inácio Rabelo. We give conditions for topological and bi-Lipschitz equivalences within a class of mixed singularities of Pham-Brieskorn type. As a consequence, we construct infinite families that are topologically trivial but have distinct bi-Lipschitz types. We also investigate this problem in the context of mixed surfaces defined by these singularities in the case of two complex variables, deriving conditions for inner, outer, and ambient bi-Lipschitz equivalences.

arxiv-2501-16429.title: Orbital Modeling of Hii 1348B: An Eccentric Young Substellar Companion in the Pleiades
arxiv-2501-16429.creator: Gabriel Weible, Kevin Wagner, Jordan Stone, Steve Ertel, Dániel Apai, Kaitlin Kratter, Jarron Leisenring
arxiv-2501-16429.description: Abstract Brown dwarfs with known physical properties (e.g., age and mass) are essential for constraining models of the formation and evolution of substellar objects. We present new high-contrast imaging observations of the circumbinary brown dwarf H ii 1348B—one of the few known substellar companions in the Pleiades cluster.

arxiv-2510-18630.title: Non-Arrhenius Li-ion transport and grain-size effects in argyrodite solid electrolytes
arxiv-2510-18630.creator: Yongliang Ou, Lena Scholz, Sanath Keshav, Yuji Ikeda, Marvin Kraft, Sergiy Divinski, Rafael Gómez-Bombarelli, Wolfgang G. Zeier, Felix Fritzen, Blazej Grabowski
arxiv-2510-18630.description: Abstract Argyrodite solid electrolytes, such as Li 6 PS 5 Cl, exhibit some of the highest known superionic conductivities. Yet, the mechanistic understanding of Li + transport in realistic argyrodite microstructures—where atomic-scale mechanisms interplay with continuum-scale dynamics at grain boundaries—remains limited.

arxiv-2512-24600.title: Dynamic Phase Transitions in Periodically Driving 1D Ising Model
arxiv-2512-24600.creator: Yuanyuan Cheng, Yuxia Zhang, Tianhui Qiu, Peipei Xin, Bao-Ming Xu
arxiv-2512-24600.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Yuanyuan Cheng, Yuxia Zhang, Tianhui Qiu, Peipei Xin, Bao-Ming Xu. This work investigates dynamical quantum phase transitions (DQPTs) in a one-dimensional Ising model subjected to a periodically modulated transverse field. In contrast to sudden quenches, we demonstrate that DQPTs can be induced in two distinct ways. First, when the system remains within a given phase–ferromagnetic (FM) or paramagnetic (PM), a resonant periodic drive can trigger a DQPT when its frequency matches the energy-level transition of the system.

arxiv-2601-22010.creator: Dongxuan ZhuThe Chinese University of Hong Kong dxzhu@se.cuhk.edu.hk, Ly Tran Ho KhanhThe Chinese University of Hong Kong hokhanhlytran@cuhk.edu.hk, Andy Yat-Ming CheungHong Kong Polytechnic University andy.cheung@polyu.edu.hk Man-Chung YueHong Kong Polytechnic University manchung.yue@polyu.edu.hk V

Sampling-based strategies inject randomness but still struggle to guarantee diversity across multiple concurrent generation runs.

plos-pone-0008035.creator: Benjamin J. Tiede, Leah A. Owens, Feng Li et al.
plos-pone-0008035.description: PLOS ONE research article. Mammary stem cells (MaSCs) play essential roles for the development of the mammary gland and its remodeling during pregnancy. However, the precise localization of MaSCs in the mammary gland and their regulation during pregnancy is unknown. Here we report a transgenic mouse model

pmc-11602140.title: SNF2L suppresses nascent DNA gap formation to promote DNA synthesis
pmc-11602140.creator: Anthony Nelligan, Huzefa Dungrawala
pmc-11602140.description: Nucleosome remodelers at replication forks function in the assembly and maturation of chromatin post DNA synthesis. The ISWI chromatin remodeler SNF2L (or SMARCA1) travels with replication forks but its contribution to DNA replication remains largely unknown. We find that fork elongation is curtailed when SNF2L is absent.

pmc-12419798.title: Prenatal light exposure affects number sense and the mental number line in young domestic chicks
pmc-12419798.creator: Rosa Rugani, Matteo Macchinizzi, Yujia Zhang, Lucia Regolin, Yanchao Bi, Rosa Rugani, Matteo Macchinizzi, Yujia Zhang, LUCIA Regolin
pmc-12419798.description: Humans order numerosity along a left-to-right mental number line (MNL), traditionally considered culturally rooted. Yet, some species at birth show spatial-numerical associations (SNA), suggesting neural origins. Various accounts link SNA to brain lateralization but lack evidence. We investigated brain lateralization effects on numerical spatialization in 100 newborn domestic chicks.

pmc-12528168.title: Targeting RNA-binding proteins with small molecules: perspectives and challenges
pmc-12528168.creator: Olivier Mpungi Konde, Williams Balela Balela, Tania Bishola Tshitenge
pmc-12528168.description: RNA-binding proteins (RBPs) play critical roles in numerous biological processes because they regulate RNA function by directly interacting with RNA molecules. In recent years, researchers have developed small molecules that can affect the function of RBPs, opening up promising new directions for drug discovery.

pmc-12728225.title: Histone acetylation homeodynamics navigates cell survival and apoptosis
pmc-12728225.creator: Kang Li, Ling Tian, Wenxin Cao, Jiahui Zhang, Wenhao Zhang, Tong Lin, Shumin Huang, Yongyu Qiu, Zifeng Ruan, Jianhao Deng, Shihui Long, Subba R. Palli, Sheng Li
pmc-12728225.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). The balance between inhibitor of apoptosis proteins (IAPs) and pro-apoptotic proteins (PAPs) tightly and precisely regulates cellular homeostasis. However, the epigenetic mechanism by which this balance is maintained in vivo remains largely unknown. Here we show that in various Drosophila tissues, the homeodynamics of H3K14ac/H3K27ac/H4K8ac on the promoters/enhancers of E93 and PAPs (rpr/hid), modulated by P300-CtBP/HDAC3, directs the decision between cell survival and the activation of hormone-induced developmental apoptosis.

pmc-12753861.title: YK-4-279 Induces Osteosarcoma Cell Cycle Arrest, DNA Damage Response, and Apoptosis by Regulating the MAPK Cascade
pmc-12753861.creator: Weifeng Wang, Yuli Zhang, Xiuqin Jia, Liren Han, Ming Xin
pmc-12753861.description: BackgroundYK-4-279, a promising anticancer agent, has demonstrated therapeutic potential against various tumors. Osteosarcoma (OS), an aggressive bone cancer primarily affecting adolescents, lacks effective treatment options. Investigating YK-4-279’s mechanisms in OS is critical for evaluating its clinical utility.MethodsUsing in vitro models, we examined YK-4-279’s effects on OS cell viability, proliferation, apoptosis, cell cycle progression, and DNA damage.

pmc-13301508.title: Pulsed field ablation for pulmonary vein isolation in atrial fibrillation: comparison between mapping integrated and non integrated 3D mapping systems
pmc-13301508.creator: L Rossi, A Dello Russo, A Setzu, C Ghiglieno, F Figus, G Mitacchione, S Bianchi, F Solimene, R Calvanese, P De Filippo, G Rovaris, M Giannotti Santoro, S Iacopino, M Malacrida, C Tondo
pmc-13301508.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundA new generation of pentaspline pulsed-field ablation (PFA) catheters with integrated three-dimensional (3D) mapping capability has recently become available. However, comparative data on procedural workflow and efficiency relative to non-integrated 3D mapping systems are lacking.PurposeTo evaluate procedural workflow and efficiency of a novel mapping-integrated PFA system for pulmonary vein isolation (PVI), compared with a non-integrated 3D mapping system in current clinical practice.MethodsThis multicenter observational study included consecutive patients undergoing first-time atrial fibrillation ablation using Farapulse PFA across 17 Italian centers.

pmc-13313565.title: Severe Peripartum Cardiomyopathy With Complete Functional Recovery: The Role of Multimodality Imaging and Optimized Medical Therapy
pmc-13313565.creator: Cesar Baltodano Dangla, Christopher Kaleb Romero Ríos, Juan Cristobal Mendoza, Mario Canales, Enamaria Villalta Garcia, Tania M Gamez, César Jeovany Urbina Maliaños, Andres Zamora, Byron Larios Alemán, Jasson E Rostran Ruíz, Winston S Castillo, Lidia Saénz
pmc-13313565.description: Peripartum cardiomyopathy (PPCM) is a life-threatening, idiopathic form of heart failure with a highly variable recovery trajectory. While normalization of the left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) is frequently achieved, identifying residual myocardial injury and subclinical dysfunction remains a significant diagnostic challenge. A 25-year-old woman presented with acute heart failure seven weeks postpartum, following a pregnancy complicated by preeclampsia.

pmc-13315057.title: Physics-informed neural network analysis of kerosene-based penta-hybrid nanofluid flow and heat transfer
pmc-13315057.creator: Basim M. Makhdoum, Hina Zahir, Nek Muhammad Katbar, Wasim Jamshed, Kamel Guedri, Mustafa Bayram, Syed M. Hussain, Sawera Batool, Hijaz Ahmad
pmc-13315057.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Kerosene oil-based penta-hybrid nanofluids have attracted significant attention because of their improved thermal conductivity, mechanical stability, and potential use in advanced heat transfer systems. In this study, a Physics-Informed Neural Network (PINN) Analysis of Kerosene-Based Penta-Hybrid Nanofluid Flow and Heat Transfer, is performed to understand the flow pattern and heat transfer characteristics of a nanostructured fluid loaded with several types of nanoparticles.

pmc-13359761.creator: Stefano Restaino, Chiara Paglietti, Federico Paparcura, Bogani Giorgio, Capozzi Vito Andrea, Ursula Catena, Antonio Raffone, Maria Orsaria, Carlo Ronsini, Giuseppe Scibilia, Tommaso Simoncini, Diego Raimondo, Violante Di Donato, Muhammed Elhadi, Giampiero Capobianco, Ramon Rovira Negre, Anna Biasioli, Monica Della Martina, Mariuzzi Laura, Stefano Uccella, Andrea Ciavattini, Errico Zupi, Renato Seracchioli, Lorenza Driul, Paolo Scollo, Anna Miryam Perrone, Pierandrea De Iaco, Martina Arcieri, Francesco Fanfani, Giuseppe Vizzielli, on behalf of the Collaborative Group

pmc-13490334.title: NEMF inhibits the proliferation and migration of ovarian cancer cells by blocking the PI3K/mTOR pathway
pmc-13490334.creator: Qian Wang, Ying Zhu, Chuangzhen Chen, Jing Fan, Ruifang Zeng, Zike Yang, Shanshan Song
pmc-13490334.description: BackgroundNuclear export mediator factor (NEMF) is considered to be a tumor suppressor in Drosophila. Based on the analysis of data from an online database, NEMF is downregulated in OV. However, the mechanism underlying its expression has not been reported thus far.

pmc-13495089.title: High-fat diet exposure, internal state, and reward value influence decision making during motivational conflict
pmc-13495089.creator: Rodolfo J. Flores, Rosario B. Jaime-Lara, Miguel A. Arenivar, Monique Awanyai, Alice M. Graham, Héctor Bravo-Rivera, Claudia Colina-Prisco, Rodrigo S.E. Ortiz Figueroa, Mari Chiles, Hugo A. Tejeda, Paule V. Joseph
pmc-13495089.description: Survival depends on adaptive decision-making wherein the benefits of seeking food are weighed against the risk of threats, a process influenced by internal states like hunger. Highly palatable, calorie-dense foods, such as a high-fat-containing diet (HFD), potently drive feeding even in the absence of hunger.

pmc-13510175.title: Parenting Profiles in Chinese Preschool Families: Parental Emotional Intelligence and Children’s Social Competence
pmc-13510175.creator: Songliang Li, Xiaosong Gai
pmc-13510175.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Parental emotional intelligence (EI) has been associated with children’s socio-emotional development, yet less is known about how parental EI is associated with naturally occurring configurations of parenting practices. This cross-sectional study investigated two complementary statistical indirect associations connecting parental EI to preschoolers’ social competence using a sample of 13,398 Chinese families: a variable-centered pathway via positive and negative parenting practices, and a person-centered pathway via distinct parenting profiles.

pmc-13528671.title: Assessment: An Unresolved Intercurrent Event in a Randomized Trial of Ciprofol versus Propofol [Letter]
pmc-13528671.creator: Shengchao Zhang, Tong Li, Yong Liu
pmc-13528671.description: ough the primary outcome of EA incidence did not differ significantly between groups, ciprofol was associated with lower Pediatric Anesthesia Emergence Delirium (PAED) scores and several favorable recovery outcomes. We would like to raise one methodological issue that may be important for interpreting the primary endpoint: the temporal relationship between rescue sedation and the prespecified 5-minute PAED assessment.

pmc-13655195.title: First‐in‐human outpatient management of recurrent NMIBC with the Multi4 instrument
pmc-13655195.creator: Miden Melle‐Hannah, Henrik Kjölhede, Henrik Bäckdahl, Martin E. Johansson, Joakim Håkansson
pmc-13655195.description: ObjectivesTo evaluate the feasibility, safety and diagnostic performance of outpatient management of recurrent non‐muscle‐invasive bladder cancer (NMIBC) under local anaesthesia using the Multi4 instrument, a series of preclinical studies were performed followed by a first‐in‐human clinical investigation. NMIBC is associated with frequent recurrence, requiring repeated transurethral resection of the bladder (TUR‐B) under anaesthesia, resulting in substantial healthcare burden.
